anomalies.description: A large dust cloud erupts suddenly in the mid-ground, consistent with a near-instantaneous explosion; the cloud expands rapidly between f0 and f1.
A large dust cloud erupts suddenly on the hillside in the background, consistent with a near-instantaneous blast event; the cloud expands rapidly between f0 and f1.

Sustained muzzle flash or secondary explosions are not visible, but continuous dust plumes and debris ejection from the same hillside location across frames f1–f15 suggest ongoing direct fire (e.g., artillery or heavy machine gun) targeting that area; no individual bullet traces visible, but pattern is consistent with repeated impacts.
A sudden, large-scale explosion occurs, producing a bright flash followed by a rapidly expanding fireball and dense smoke plume; visible in frames f3–f7.

Sustained aftermath of the explosion: massive smoke/dust cloud obscures the scene, with possible secondary detonations or structural collapse indicated by shifting debris and continued plume expansion (frames f7–f15).

A large dust cloud rapidly expands upward and outward from the ground, consistent with a near-surface explosion; the cloud's shape and sudden onset (visible between f6 and f7) indicate a blast rather than wind or vehicle movement.; A large dust and smoke plume erupts violently from the ground near a tank, expanding rapidly upward and outward—characteristic of a nearby explosion (e.g., IED or artillery impact). The plume is densest at f0 and continues to expand through f3.

Armored vehicles (tanks) are actively maneuvering in a dusty, debris-strewn environment with ongoing explosions and visible damage (e.g., bodies on road at f9–f12), indicating active combat engagement. The sustained presence of multiple tanks moving under fire supports ongoing fighting.

Two armored vehicles are visible moving through a dusty, chaotic environment with ongoing smoke/dust plumes; their proximity, orientation, and context suggest active combat engagement (e.g., maneuvering under fire or advancing in contested terrain). No direct weapon discharge is visible, but the sustained dynamic scene supports mutual armed conflict.
A large dust cloud erupts suddenly to the right of the tank, expanding rapidly and obscuring the background—consistent with a near-ground explosion or IED detonation.

A military armored vehicle (likely a tank) advances along a debris-strewn road amid heavy dust/smoke, with visible casualties (bodies) on the ground in early frames; context suggests active combat engagement.
